name: promega-engineering-os-softserve
description: Softserve variant of promega-engineering-os. Same workspace structure and commands as the standard plugin, but meeting-sync is rewired onto the Promega-internal Softserve MS365 connector (Microsoft Graph). Unlocks richer event data: three-column Attendees table (Name, Email, Response) populated with the display names Softserve returns, Recurrence row from series-master fetches, Recording row from list-meeting-recordings, simpler transcript matching by createdDateTime (no base64 ID decoding). Also adds get-current-user as a name-resolution fallback in /join-team. Requires the Softserve MS365 connector enabled in Claude Customize - if you don't have Softserve access, install the standard promega-engineering-os plugin instead. Workspace files written by either variant are forward-compatible with the other.
